description: This file is a shell script used to wait for a specified TCP host and port to become available. It is typically used in wait-for-it.sh-style scripts for service initialization and orchestration.

methods.name: echoerr
methods.description: Outputs error messages to stderr unless in quiet mode.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: wait_for
methods.description: Waits for the specified host and port to become available, with optional timeout.

methods.name: wait_for_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps the wait_for function to support signal handling and timeouts.
